headline: He's truly become an integral part of our product marketing team.
quote: We've worked with Ben for a couple years and he's truly become an integral part of our product marketing team. Ben is able to bridge the gap between strategy and execution and has both supported and driven major initiatives for us. He ramps up quickly on products and personas, is a critical thinker and has a strong core set of product marketing skills. His work is high-quality and he has gained the respect of our cross functional partners and leadership team.
name: Lindsey Bly
role: Senior Director, Product and Corporate Marketing, CaptivateIQ
